    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.

be used.

graph containing 4 mutually adjacent vertices (K4) is no.

TARGET = ThreeSat
3-SAT.

clause contain at least one true literal.

But careful: for edge clauses, if we use a fresh variable per edge-color pair, that's fine. Actually we can use a single fresh variable globally? If a∨b is true, then both clauses are satisfied regardless of y. If a∨b is false, then first requires y true, second requires y false — contradiction. So sharing y works fine and is simpler. But careful with variable count and distinctness: y must differ from a and b. If we use one global y, y must not equal any x variable. That's fine.

Actually, we can also avoid padding by using a different standard trick, but padding is fine.

So the reduction is correct.
